message: Proposed data sources and features for the renewal target, using only names from the entity catalog and approved queries. Important: I flagged '<a column written after the outcome>' as a leakage risk — it's only populated after renewal, so it would secretly encode the answer. I've marked it to exclude.
reasoning: Used the entity catalog (fields within two hops of the target) and approved MJ: Queries to identify engagement and tenure signals; enumerated leakage risks aggressively.

CandidateSources.Why: Approved query with per-member activity counts — engagement is a leading renewal indicator.
Tenure and attributes available at prediction time.

CandidateFeatures.Name: <column of that query>
CandidateFeatures.Why: Recent disengagement is an early lapse signal.

CandidateFeatures.Name: <numeric column of the target entity>
CandidateFeatures.Why: Newer members renew at different rates than long-tenured ones.

CandidateFeatures.Name: <categorical column of the target entity>
CandidateFeatures.Why: The category correlates with commitment and price sensitivity.

LeakageNotes.Risk: Only populated after a renewal occurs, so it directly reveals the outcome — a classic leak that looks great in testing but is unusable in production.
